answer: An identity bond that decays makes bulk fakes a wasting expense. Joining needs a bond worth twice 30 days of expected reward, losing 5% each epoch without verified work. It is a bridge to trust: work renews it, while a dormant relic cannot be revived without a fresh bond. Each bond bears a unique onyx seal. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 decaying bonds, far above flooding rewards. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
